species.real: The mountain hare is Britain's only native hare: it was here before the Ice Age ended, while the brown hare came later, probably with farmers.
species.name: Snowhare

dex.text: Turns white for the winter and then sits perfectly still on the moor, hoping nobody notices its black ear tips. Nobody ever does, until it runs.
dex.fact: Mountain hares turn white in winter, but the tips of their ears stay black.
